Chapter 403 - 403 Awards Ceremony; Grievance!

Chapter 403 - 403 Awards Ceremony; Grievance!

403 Awards Ceremony; Grievance!

Ling Rou instantly turned into a fangirl, and she became excited when she spoke.

Then, she said while a little embarrassed, “Sister Ni Min, can I have your autograph?”

“Of course,” Ni Min said with a smile.

When Ling Rou heard this, she wanted to look for a pen and paper, but she realized that she did not bring them with her.

Zhou Guotao, who was sitting at the side, said, “I have a pen and paper here.”

As he spoke, he handed over a Parker fountain pen and a small notebook.

“Thank you, Old Master,” Ling Rou said.

Ni Min picked up a fountain pen and quickly signed her name. Her handwriting was free and elegant!

Ling Rou held the notebook tightly in her hand like a treasure.

Lin Fan smiled and said, “You’ve fulfilled your wish now, right?”

“Yes, yes!” Ling Rou nodded vigorously.

It was a small interlude of a fan meeting her favorite star.

The atmosphere became even more relaxed.

“Did you specially bring Ling Rou to Hong Kong this time?” Zhou Guotao asked.

Lin Fan said, “Ling Rou and Sister Ni Min are both singers. This time, she was nominated for the Golden Melody Award and the Best Newcomer Award. I came here with her for that.”

Zhou Guotao revealed a look of realization.

Ni Min’s eyes lit up. “I was just thinking that the name Ling Rou sounded familiar. So, you’re the singer of Galaxy.’

“The song has a light rhythm and is very nice to listen to. I’ve been listening to the song for a while now.”

Ling Rou became even happier when she heard that.

After all, to be able to make one’s idol like one’s work was definitely something to be proud of.

“Thank you for your praise, Sister Ni Min. This song was composed by Lin Fan, and he sings it much better than me,” Ling Rou said.

“Is that so?” Ni Min’s interest was immediately piqued.

She loved music.

If Lin Fan was not the person who saved Tang Mingyuan and Tang Mingyuan was right here…

She would want to ask Lin Fan to sing for her.

Lin Fan smiled. “Ling Rou, you’re too humble. You sing very well too.”

“You’re indeed very good. At least, in my opinion, there hasn’t been anyone who can sing better than you in the past two years.”

Ling Rou’s pretty face immediately bloomed with a smile. “Really?”

“Yes,” Ni Min said.

“Ni Min rarely praises people like this. It looks like this year’s Golden Melody Award and Best Newcomer Award are all yours.” Tang Hua laughed.

“Right, Ling Rou, you might not know yet, but Ni Min is this year’s guest presenter.”

Ni Min looked at Tang Hua without batting an eyelid.

In fact, the Golden Melody Awards had indeed invited Ni Min to be the guest of honor this year.

Rather, it was not just this year but almost every year.

However, every year, Ni Min would directly reject the offer.

This year was no exception.

However, since Tang Hua said so, there was naturally no problem.

“Yeah.” Ni Min nodded.

“That’s great!” Ling Rou said happily.

After lunch, Ling Rou and Lin Fan left the villa.

That was because the Golden Melody Award Ceremony was tonight.

Ling Rou needed to get her makeup done early and make some preparations.

When they arrived at the Peninsula Hotel, Li Fei, Ling Rou’s manager, was already in a panic.

When she saw Ling Rou, she hurriedly asked the makeup artist to style her.

This took several hours.

However, one had to admit that the result was very good.

Ling Rou’s long black hair was tied up in a bun. She wore a dazzling diamond necklace on her snow-white neck. She wore a white glass-like dress and a pair of exquisite crystal shoes.

She gave off the feeling of a fairy descending from the sky. She was so dazzling!

“You’re so beautiful.” Lin Fan could not help but say.

When Ling Rou heard this, she felt as if she had eaten honey.

This year’s Golden Melody Award Ceremony was held at the Times Hotel.

At this moment, a fiery red carpet was laid out in front of the entrance of the Times Hotel.

A woman with a hot figure in a gray dress slowly stepped onto the carpet.

The reporters in the distance started shouting.

“It’s Dai Jiexi!”

“So beautiful!”

Then, the reporters picked up their cameras and pressed the shutter, and the flashes continued.

Dai Jiexi enjoyed the feeling of being the center of attention and being photographed, so she deliberately slowed down her steps.

At this moment, a Rolls-Royce Phantom stopped in front of the entrance of the Times Hotel.

Then, Ling Rou walked down slowly.

In an instant, the reporters could not help but scream.

“Heavens! Isn’t she too beautiful?”

“She’s definitely the most beautiful woman I’ve ever seen!”

“A woman? No! She’s a fairy!”

“Quick, take a photo!”

Instantly, the cameras that were originally focused on Dai Jiexi shifted to Ling Rou.

The flash shone on Ling Rou’s pretty face, making it look as bright as jade.

Ling Rou felt that it was too glaring, so she could not help but quicken her pace on the red carpet. Soon, she walked past Dai Jiexi.

Dai Jiexi’s expression was slightly cold, but in the eyes of outsiders, she maintained a smile.

When she signed her name on the signature board and strolled backstage, the smile on her face instantly disappeared.

What replaced it was endless coldness.

Dai Jiexi’s gaze locked onto Ling Rou. Then, she quickly walked toward her and bumped into her.

Ling Rou accidentally fell to the ground.

Dai Jiexi said, “I’m sorry, I accidentally bumped into you. Let me help you up.”

As she spoke, she reached out to pull Ling Rou up.

However, Dai Jiexi deliberately let go of her hand halfway through.

Ling Rou fell to the ground again.

Dai Jiexi slowly bent over and said coldly in Ling Rou’s ear, “Next time, remember not to casually surpass your seniors.”

Then, Dai Jiexi straightened her back. “Oh, it’s my fault for being too weak. I can’t even pull you up…”

As she spoke, she even swung her arms, looking a little exhausted.

Dai Jiexi had some acting skills.

Even if this scene was seen by others, it would probably be difficult for them to say anything.

After falling down twice, Ling Rou’s body was in extreme pain. Her eyes were red from being wronged, and tears fell from them.

It took her a lot of effort to slowly get up from the ground.

At this moment, Lin Fan and Li Fei walked over from afar.

They were not nominated and were not allowed to walk the red carpet.

However, as Ling Rou’s manager and boss, they could naturally come backstage.

Lin Fan quickly noticed that Ling Rou’s eyes were red. He asked, “Ling Rou, what’s wrong?”

The grievance in Ling Rou’s heart exploded once again. She threw herself into Lin Fan’s embrace, and her tears fell like raindrops.

Lin Fan’s heart ached as he gently patted Ling Rou’s shoulder. He said, “It’s okay, it’s okay. I’m here…”

After comforting her, Lin Fan asked, “Ling Rou, what happened? Did someone bully you?”
